questions.question: I hop on big feet and carry my baby in a pouch. Who am I?
questions.fact: A baby kangaroo is called a joey!
questions.subject: Red kangaroo

questions.question: I buzz from flower to flower and make honey. Who am I?
questions.fact: Bees dance to tell their friends where the flowers are!
questions.subject: Western honey bee

questions.question: I am black and white and munch bamboo all day. Who am I?
questions.fact: Pandas can spend 12 hours a day eating bamboo!
questions.subject: Giant panda

questions.question: I have a big fluffy mane and a mighty roar. Who am I?
questions.fact: A lion's roar can be heard 8 kilometers away!
questions.subject: Lion

questions.question: I used to be a caterpillar, and now I have colorful wings. Who am I?
questions.subject: Monarch butterfly

questions.question: I sleep most of the day high up in eucalyptus trees. Who am I?
questions.fact: Koalas eat almost nothing but eucalyptus leaves!
questions.subject: Koala

questions.question: My neck is so long I eat leaves from the treetops. Who am I?
questions.fact: A giraffe's tongue is dark purple and about 50 cm long!
questions.subject: Giraffe
